compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: commit-workflow-validation.md contains the extracted local-validation steps (format, lint, type-check, test-status recording, review gate)

## Description
Create plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md. Move verbatim bodies of COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Steps 1.5, 2, 3, 3a, 4.5, and 5 into this new file. In COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md, replace those sections with placeholder section headers that reference Step 0.6 (added in Task 2). Pure refactor: preserve every command and breadcrumb log line exactly. Also add a "Always-On vs Gated Hooks" section listing the 6 always-on hooks (check-portability, check-shim-refs, check-contract-schemas, check-referential-integrity, check-plugin-self-ref, pre-commit-enforcement-boundary-check) and 3 gated hooks (pre-commit-test-gate, pre-commit-review-gate, pre-commit-test-quality-gate). Add a "Network partition during CI" security caveat noting that enforcement.strategy=ci leaves unvalidated code committed when the network is partitioned.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md (create)
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md (modify — sections excised)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Extracted commands present in new file (5+ matches)
  Verify: test "$(grep -cE 'make format-modified|make lint-ruff|make lint-mypy|test-status|REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md)" -ge 5
- [ ] Referential integrity preserved
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-referential-integrity.sh
- [ ] Validation sections removed from COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md
  Verify: ! grep -qE "^## Step (1\.5|2|3|3a|4\.5|5)" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] Canonical always-on vs gated hook list present
  Verify: grep -q "Always-On vs Gated Hooks" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md
- [ ] Network partition caveat present
  Verify: grep -qi "network partition" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
